comments.value:
If there is a confirmation I'd prefer it to be another level of the menu. 

I haven't accidentally reset an avatar yet. Maybe this is aided by controller drift?

@{62df7cd83e007e467295c4e1|full_name}: I'm usually in desktop mode, so it is mostly due to fast gestures. Since the avatar I usually use has some common expressions on the right side of the wheel, I usually do a fast flick, which can reset the avatar when I was on the scaling menu previously.
I have resetted my avatar by accident multiple times from the menu, so not from the radial menu. So if it can be added to the menu that would be great.
This is often very annoying in my experience. I've often accidentally reset avatars I use, then have to change everything back the way I liked things. Please implement this feature into the game.

generally to provide a good user experience, any "reset" or "delete" action should have a confirmation, or be easily undone if pressed by mistake. (ideally both)

the hierarchy of these actions should also be considered; in VRChat, often these options are right next to frequently-used actions (Action Menu), or are the most prominent button in the menu (Quick Menu Expressions Wing)

- ideally, reset actions should be placed somewhere accessible, but not frequently accessed -> out of sight until needed, not nested among the day-to-day actions.
As my stick drift loves the reset button, I would like having a confirmation message for it.
God damn this shit is infuriating fix it

details: Since VRChat added the avatar scaling system to the same radial menu page as the reset avatar option, I frequently find myself accidentally resetting my avatar. It would be nice to have a confirmation request before doing so, since it can take a while to set all the settings again.
title: Ask for confirmation before resetting the avatar when using the radial menu
